description: Medicare clinician lookup — Look up Medicare-enrolled doctors and clinicians by last_name plus city/state (or npi) from the CMS Doctors and Clinicians file: credential, primary and secondary specialties, medical school, graduation year, telehealth, Medicare assignment, and every practice location with group name and size; specialty filter by substring (e.g. cardio). Optional: first_name, zip, specialty, npi, limit (1-50). Not a license check. Source: CMS Provider Data Catalog (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_clinicians
